about_the_game:
The Quantum Mystery

Investigate the Threads of Reality

Malevolent Madness is a first-person psychological horror and forensic mystery that places scientific reasoning at the center of terror. This is not a story about monsters lurking in the dark it is about understanding the horrifying logic of a discovery that should never have been made.

You play as a specialized scientist abducted into the hidden laboratory of a disgraced professor whose experiments with time and quantum instability have begun to fracture reality itself. Survival is only the beginning. To escape, you must think like a researcher, an analyst, and a forensic investigator piecing together evidence left behind by a mind consumed by obsession.

The time machine is real.
And it is already running.

Key Investigative Features

🔍 Forensic Evidence Collection
Explore sealed laboratories, maintenance corridors, and contaminated test chambers to recover biological samples, DNA markers, and technical artifacts. Every collected fragment feeds into your understanding of the machine’s structure and the catastrophic consequences of its misuse.

🧩 Scientific Deduction & Puzzle Design
Progression demands more than item collection. You must actively correlate the professor’s failed experiments, operational logs, and anomalous data to reconstruct how the machine functions and how it can be neutralized before irreversible collapse occurs.

📓 Analytical Narrative Reconstruction
Every document, audio log, and research note is a component of a larger equation. By reviewing evidence through a scientific lens, you uncover the truth behind your abduction, the professor’s descent into madness, and the ethical line he chose to cross.

👁️ Strategic Stealth & Behavioral Analysis
An advanced AI-controlled threat stalks the facility. There is no direct confrontation survival depends on observing patterns, analyzing movement logic, and exploiting environmental systems through stealth and parkour-based traversal.

🎧 Sensory-Based Investigation
Sound and visual design are not atmospheric filler they are investigative tools. Subtle audio distortions, visual glitches, and environmental anomalies serve as warnings, clues, and indicators of reality destabilization.

Solve the Malevolence

The machine is active.
Timelines are destabilizing.
The boundary between universes is eroding.

Will you solve the professor’s final equation and shut the system down…
or become another corrupted data point in an experiment that devours worlds?

content_descriptors.notes:
🔞 General Adult Content Description
This game contains content that may not be suitable for everyone. Players may encounter the following elements:

Sudden horror scenes and unexpected sound effects: There are sudden visual and auditory elements that may startle players.

Intense tension atmosphere: Dark and disturbing environments may cause players to feel uneasy.

Being chased by artificial intelligence and escape mechanics: Players may have to escape from enemy AI characters, which can create stressful moments.

Violent scenes: The game may include violent elements such as characters being harmed or threatened.

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-4340 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 670 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1650 or AMD Radeon™ HD 7950
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-2500K or AMD Ryzen™ R5 1600X Processor
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 970 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1660 or AMD Radeon™ R9 390 / AMD Radeon™ RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: In Malevolent Madness, explore a chilling world filled with mysteries and puzzles. As a gifted scientist, uncover the dark secret of a hidden time machine while evading sinister foes. Solve intricate challenges and unveil the truth behind your father's disappearance before reality unravels.
